editorial.blurb: Nawaz Gulshan brings authentic Hyderabadi flavors to life with generously portioned curries and biryanis that earn devoted praise for their careful spicing and homemade quality.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Zafrani mutton marag or mutton haleem for the dishes that consistently transport diners back to Hyderabad—arrive early or call ahead as these signature preparations are customer favorites.
